item.title: Performance Monitoring: Visible reduction in data within Performance Monitoring dashboards and BigQuery exports. [service_disruption]
item.description: We are investigating a system issue. To protect platform stability, we have limited the volume of collected data. Expect a visible reduction in data within Performance Monitoring dashboards and BigQuery exports.
